page.overview:
Who is Iago?

Bob Hoskins Kenneth Branagh Ian McKellan Ewan McGregor

Iago is the main antagonist of William Shakespeare's Othello. He is the ensign and supposed friend of the Moorish general Othello who seeks to make the general believe that his wife Desdemona is cheating on him. His motives - including jealousy, racism, thwarted ambition, and sadism - have been the source of academic debate and analysis for hundreds of years.
